function: Joint BS beamforming and RIS phase-shift design for SNR maximization: the SNN outputs the RIS phases and the BS uses maximum-ratio transmission (pp. 3-4).
system: Downlink, BS with M=4 antennas, one NeuroRIS (reflecting, passive, varactor-based continuous phase) with N=8 to 64 unit cells, single-antenna UE, flat fading; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 2-4).
method: Spiking neural network with five LIF layers (32N, 16N, 8N, 4N, N), rate coding; unsupervised training with surrogate-gradient backpropagation through time and Adam (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulation of the scenario of [22]: Rayleigh fading, path loss 20.4 log10(d/dref) dB; 10^5 training and 10^4 test samples from the same statistical models (p. 4).
test_conditions: Same Rayleigh model for training and testing; test sweep over transmit SNR (-20 to 20 dB) and N = 8 to 64; no unseen scenario (p. 4).
baselines: Learned: conventional-RIS ANN of [10] (DNN in Fig. 3a); non-learned: semi-definite relaxation (SDR) optimization [10] (p. 4).
metrics: Rate log2(1+SNR) in bits/s/Hz versus transmit SNR (Fig. 3a, p. 4); average controller energy consumption versus N (Fig. 3b, p. 5).
complexity: Energy computed from FLOP counts: 3e-3 to 3e-2 μJ for N = 8 to 64, against 0.2 to 20 μJ for the ANN (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "all the channel coefficients follow the Rayleigh model"; a custom simulator with a simple path loss, and no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "test samples again drawn by the described statistical channel models"; training and testing use the same models, and no unseen scenario, antenna configuration or dataset is tested.
q3_support: p. 4: "The ANN network used in the simulation follows the approach in [10]"; p. 4: "semi-definite relaxation (SDR) optimization framework is shown for comparison purposes"
q4_support: p. 5: "The energy consumption is given by multiplying the floating-point operations (FLOPS) number by their energy cost"
q5_support: p. 4: "all the channel coefficients follow the Rayleigh model"; the channels are simulated, and no link, DOI, release statement, public dataset or measured data appears in the paper.
notes: Included because the unsupervised SNN designs the RIS phase shifts (area 3, pp. 3-4); the hardware novelty (a neuromorphic controller with a varactor RIS, p. 2) is not the learned function, and the BS beamformer is closed-form maximum-ratio transmission for a given u (p. 3). q3: Fig. 3a plots SDR, DNN and SNN rate curves (p. 4); the legend says DNN while the text says ANN. q4: the cost is reported as energy computed from operation counts (p. 5), not as an order of complexity or a count of operations, so the reviewer should confirm that it counts. The SNN size scales with N (p. 3), and the paper does not say whether one network is trained per N.
